# Support

## Usage questions

For help using NResilience - configuration, which policy to use, and similar:

- Search the [documentation](../docs/index.md) first - the [troubleshooting
  guide](../docs/troubleshooting.md) and the [FAQ](../docs/faq.md) answer most
  common questions.
- Open a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/nresilience/NResilience/discussions).

## Bugs and feature requests

For suspected bugs, or concrete feature requests with a use case:

- Open an [issue](https://github.com/nresilience/NResilience/issues/new/choose)
  and choose the appropriate template.

Before opening a bug report, check the existing issues and the
[changelog](../CHANGELOG.md) to see whether it is already tracked or already
fixed in an unreleased version.

## Security issues

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not open a public issue for a suspected
vulnerability.
